```{r locaties}

figuren <- "../../Output/figuren/"
figuren_larvaal <- str_c(figuren, "larvaal/")
figuren_larvaal_SI <- str_c(figuren_larvaal, "SI/")
figuren_larvaal_delta_SI <- str_c(figuren_larvaal, "delta_SI/")
figuren_adult <- str_c(figuren, "adult/")

figuren_adult_delta_SI <- str_c(figuren_adult, "delta_SI/")

```


```{r ophalen gegevens}

Data_larvaal <- NULL
for(scen in Scenarios) {
  for(alt in Alternatives) {
    cat(str_c("scenario = ", scen, ";  alternatief = ", alt, "\nl"))
    # ng <- ifelse(alt == "2050REF_C", "", nevengeul)
    file_name <- 
      str_c("../../Output/resultaten_fint_", alt, "_", scen, "_larvaal.csv")
    Data_larvaal <-
      Data_larvaal %>% 
      bind_rows(read_delim(file_name, 
                           delim = ";", 
                           escape_double = FALSE, 
                           trim_ws = TRUE) %>% 
                  mutate(alternative = alt,
                         scenario = scen))
  }
}


Data_larvaal %<>% 
  mutate(jaar = case_when(jaar == 2009 ~ 2046,
                          jaar == 2010 ~ 2047,
                          jaar == 2011 ~ 2048,
                          jaar == 2012 ~ 2049,
                          jaar == 2013 ~ 2050,
                          TRUE ~ jaar),
         afst_int = as.integer(floor(afst))) %>% 
  group_by(afst_int) %>% 
  mutate(OMES = min(OMES)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(OMES,jaar,alternative,scenario,afst,afst_int,x,y,everything()) %>% 
  mutate(alternative = factor(alternative, levels = Alternatives),
         scenario = factor(scenario, levels = Scenarios))



Data_adult <- NULL
for(scen in Scenarios) {
  for(alt in Alternatives) {
    cat(str_c("scenario = ", scen, ";  alternatief = ", alt, "\nl"))
    # ng <- ifelse(alt == "2050REF_C", "", nevengeul)
    file_name <-
      str_c("../../Output/resultaten_fint_", alt, "_", scen, "_adult_1D.csv")
    Data_adult <-
      Data_adult %>% 
      bind_rows(read_delim(file_name, 
                           delim = ";", 
                           escape_double = FALSE, 
                           trim_ws = TRUE) %>% 
                  mutate(alternative = alt,
                         scenario = scen))
  }
}

Data_adult %<>% 
  mutate(jaar = case_when(jaar == 2009 ~ 2046,
                          jaar == 2010 ~ 2047,
                          jaar == 2011 ~ 2048,
                          jaar == 2012 ~ 2049,
                          jaar == 2013 ~ 2050,
                          TRUE ~ jaar),
         afst_int = as.integer(floor(afst))) %>% 
  group_by(afst_int) %>% 
  mutate(OMES = min(OMES)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(OMES,jaar,alternative,scenario,afst,afst_int,x,y,everything()) %>% 
  mutate(alternative = factor(alternative, levels = Alternatives),
         scenario = factor(scenario, levels = Scenarios))

```


```{r variabelen}

vars.group <- c("alternative","scenario","OMES","jaar")

vars.env.larvaal <- c("oxy","sal","SPM","zoopl","depth","vel")
nams.env.larvaal <- c("Oxygen (mg/l)","Salinity (ppm)","SPM (mg/l)","Zooplankton (mgC/l)","Water depth (m)","Water velocity (m/s)")

vars.env.adult <- c("oxy","sal","depth","vel")
nams.env.adult <- c("Oxygen (mg/l)","Salinity (ppm)","Water depth (m)", "Water velocity (m/s)")

vars.score.larvaal <- c("SI", str_c("SI_", vars.env.larvaal))
nams.score.larvaal <- c("All","Only oxygen","Only salinity","Only SPM","Only zooplankton","Only water depth","Only water velocity")

vars.score.adult <- c("SI", str_c("SI_", vars.env.adult))
nams.score.adult <- c("All","Only oxygen","Only salinity","Only water depth","Only water velocity")

```


```{r data environment per km}

Data_larvaal_env <- 
  Data_larvaal %>% 
  select(all_of(vars.group), afst, all_of(vars.env.larvaal)) %>% 
  group_by_at(c(all_of(vars.group), "afst")) %>% 
  summarise_all(mean, na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(afst = as.integer(floor(afst))) %>% 
  group_by_at(c(all_of(vars.group), "afst")) %>%
  summarise_all(mean, na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(OMES = ordered(OMES),
         jaar = ordered(jaar)) %>% 
  rename_at(vars.env.larvaal, ~ nams.env.larvaal)

Data_larvaal_long_env <- 
  Data_larvaal_env %>% 
  gather(key="Variable", value="Value",
         all_of(nams.env.larvaal)) %>% 
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = nams.env.larvaal))


Data_adult_env <- 
  Data_adult %>% 
  select(all_of(vars.group), afst, all_of(vars.env.adult)) %>% 
  mutate(afst = as.integer(floor(afst))) %>% 
  group_by_at(c(all_of(vars.group), "afst")) %>%
  summarise_all(mean, na.rm = TRUE) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(OMES = ordered(OMES),
         jaar = ordered(jaar)) %>% 
  rename_at(vars.env.adult, ~ nams.env.adult)

Data_adult_long_env <- Data_adult_env %>% 
  gather(key="Variable", value="Value",
         all_of(nams.env.adult)) %>% 
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = nams.env.adult))

```


```{r figuren omgevingsvariabelen larvaal, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}

vars_env_noYear <- c("Water depth (m)","Water velocity (m/s)")
vars_env_year <- setdiff(nams.env.larvaal, vars_env_noYear)

wd <- 10
ht <- 4
txts <- 12
lbls <- 4

plot_func <- function (dat) {
  max_val <- max(dat$max_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_val <- min(dat$min_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  var <- unique(dat$Variable)
  ggplot(dat, aes(afst, mean_value)) +
       geom_line(aes(color=alternative), size=0.7) +
       geom_line(aes(y = min_value, color=alternative), linetype=2, size=0.5) +
       geom_line(aes(y = max_value, color=alternative), linetype=2, size=0.5) +
       # geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min_value, ymax = max_value, fill = alternative), alpha = 0.25) +
       # scale_linetype_manual(values = c(3,2,1,1,1)) +
       geom_text(data=Afst.sal, aes(x=afstand_monding, y=min_val, label=locatie), 
                 size = lbls, angle=90, nudge_x = -3, nudge_y = 0.03*(max_val-min_val), hjust="left") +
       geom_vline(data = Afst.sal, aes(xintercept = afstand_monding), linetype = 3, color = "grey25") +
       xlab("Distance from Vlissingen (km)") +
       ylab(var) +
       facet_wrap(~ scenario) +
       theme_bw() + 
       theme(strip.text = element_text(size = txts),
             text = element_text(size = txts))
}

plots <- 
  Data_larvaal_long_env %>%
  filter(#scenario == "AplusCH",
         Variable %in% vars_env_year) %>% 
  group_by(alternative, scenario, OMES, afst, Variable) %>% 
  summarize(mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_value = min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_value = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  do(plot = plot_func(.))
plots$plot

map2(paste0(figuren_larvaal, "lineplot_larvaal_km_", simplify(map(str_split(plots$Variable, " \\("), ~ str_replace(.[1], " ", "_"))), ".jpg"),
     plots$plot, ggsave, dpi = 600, width = wd, height = ht)
```

```{r data SI per km}

Data_larvaal_SI <- 
  Data_larvaal %>% 
  select(vars.group, afst, all_of(vars.score.larvaal)) %>% 
  group_by_at(c(vars.group, "afst")) %>% 
  summarise_all(funs(mean(sort(., decreasing=TRUE)[1:3], na.rm=TRUE))) %>% 
  ungroup()

Data_larvaal_long_SI <- 
  Data_larvaal_SI %>%  
  mutate(afst = as.integer(floor(afst))) %>% 
  rename_at(vars.score.larvaal, ~ nams.score.larvaal) %>%
  gather(key="Type_Score",value="Score",
         all_of(nams.score.larvaal)) %>%
  group_by_at(c(vars.group, "afst", "Type_Score")) %>% 
  summarise_all(funs(Score_lwr = quantile(., 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
                     Score_upr = quantile(., 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
                     Score = mean(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(OMES = ordered(OMES),
         jaar = ordered(jaar),
         Type_Score = factor(Type_Score, levels = nams.score.larvaal))

Data_larvaal_SI_gem <- 
  Data_larvaal_long_SI %>% 
  select(-jaar) %>% 
  group_by(alternative, scenario, OMES, afst, Type_Score) %>% 
  summarise_at(vars(Score), funs(Score_max = max(., na.rm = TRUE),
                                 Score_min = min(., na.rm = TRUE),
                                 Score = mean(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  ungroup()


Data_adult_long_SI <- 
  Data_adult %>%  
  select(vars.group, afst, all_of(vars.score.adult)) %>% 
  mutate(afst = as.integer(floor(afst))) %>% 
  rename_at(vars.score.adult, ~ nams.score.adult) %>%
  gather(key="Type_Score",value="Score",
         all_of(nams.score.adult)) %>%
  group_by_at(c(vars.group, "afst", "Type_Score")) %>% 
  summarise_all(funs(Score_lwr = quantile(., 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
                     Score_upr = quantile(., 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
                     Score = mean(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(OMES = ordered(OMES),
         jaar = ordered(jaar),
         Type_Score = factor(Type_Score, levels = nams.score.adult))


Data_adult_SI_gem <- 
  Data_adult_long_SI %>% 
  select(-jaar) %>% 
  group_by(alternative, scenario, OMES, afst, Type_Score) %>% 
  summarise_at(vars(Score), funs(Score_max = max(., na.rm = TRUE),
                                 Score_min = min(., na.rm = TRUE),
                                 Score = mean(., na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  ungroup()

```


```{r figuren SI larvaal per km, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}

wd <- 10
ht <- 4
txts <- 12
lbls <- 4


plot_func <- function (dat) {
  max_val <- max(dat$Score_max, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_val <- min(dat$Score_min, na.rm = TRUE)
  var <- unique(dat$Type_Score)
  ggplot(dat, aes(afst, Score)) +
       geom_line(aes(color=alternative), size=0.7) +
       geom_line(aes(y = Score_min, color=alternative), linetype=2, size=0.5) +
       geom_line(aes(y = Score_max, color=alternative), linetype=2, size=0.5) +
       # geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min_value, ymax = max_value, fill = alternative), alpha = 0.25) +
       # scale_linetype_manual(values = c(3,2,1,1,1)) +
       geom_text(data=Afst.sal, aes(x=afstand_monding, y=min_val, label=locatie), 
                 size = lbls, angle=90, nudge_x = -3, nudge_y = 0.03*(max_val-min_val), hjust="left") +
       geom_vline(data = Afst.sal, aes(xintercept = afstand_monding), linetype = 3, color = "grey25") +
       xlab("Distance from Vlissingen (km)") +
       ylab(var) +
       facet_wrap(~ scenario) +
       theme_bw() + 
       theme(strip.text = element_text(size = txts),
             text = element_text(size = txts))
}

for (sc in Scenarios) {
  Data_larvaal_long_SI %>%
    filter(scenario == sc) %>%
    mutate(Type_Score = factor(Type_Score, levels = sort(unique(Type_Score)))) %>%
    {ggplot(., aes(x=afst, y=alternative)) +
        geom_tile(aes(fill=Score)) +
        scale_fill_gradientn(name = "SI",
                             # colours = rev(myPalette(100)),
                             colours = myPalette(100),
                             limits = c(0,1)) +
        geom_text(data=Afst.sal,
                  aes(x=afstand_monding, y = levels(.$alternative)[nlevels(.$alternative)], label = locatie),
                  size = lbls, angle=90, nudge_x = -5, nudge_y = -0.5, hjust="left", color = "grey25") +
        geom_vline(data = Afst.sal, aes(xintercept = afstand_monding), linetype = 3, color = "grey25") +
        scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(.$alternative))) +
        ggtitle(unique(.$scenario)) +
        xlab("Distance from Vlissingen (km)") + ylab("") +
        facet_grid(jaar ~ Type_Score) +
        theme_bw() + 
        theme(strip.text = element_text(size = txts),
              text = element_text(size = txts))} %>% 
    print()
  
  ggsave(paste0(figuren_larvaal_SI, sc, "/tileplot_larvaal_km_SI_all_", sc, ".jpg"), dpi = 600, width = 10, height = 5)
}
```

```{r figuren SI adult per km, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
plot_func <- function (dat) {
  max_val <- max(dat$Score_max, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_val <- min(dat$Score_min, na.rm = TRUE)
  var <- unique(dat$Type_Score)
  ggplot(dat, aes(afst, Score)) +

    geom_line(aes(y = Score_min, color=alternative), linetype=2, size=0.5) +
```

```{r data verschil per km}
mean_fun <- function(x) {if_else(any(!is.na(x)), mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), NaN) %>% if_else(is.infinite(.),NaN,.) %>% if_else(abs(.) < 0.05, 0, .)}
max_fun <- function(x) {if_else(any(!is.na(x)), max(x, na.rm = TRUE), NaN) %>% if_else(is.infinite(.),NaN,.) %>% if_else(abs(.) < 0.0, 0, .)}
min_fun <- function(x) {if_else(any(!is.na(x)), min(x, na.rm = TRUE), NaN) %>% if_else(is.infinite(.),NaN,.) %>% if_else(abs(.) < 0.05, 0, .)}
eval_fun <- function(x) {if_else(any(!is.na(x)), min(x, na.rm = TRUE), NaN) %>% if_else(is.infinite(.),NaN,.) %>% if_else(abs(.) < 0.05, 0, .)}

              names_from = alternative,
              values_from = c(Score, Score_min)) %>%
  mutate(delta_mean_C1 = `Score_C1` - `Score_REF`,
         # delta_mean_C2 = `Score_C2` - `Score_REF`,
         delta_mean_C3 = `Score_C3` - `Score_REF`,
         delta_min_C1 = `Score_min_C1` - `Score_min_REF`,
```

```{r trans functies}

# transform function
lal_trans_transform <-
  function(tr, pw) {
    function(x) case_when (
      x <= -tr ~ -(abs(x)^(1/pw)),
      x >= tr ~ x^(1/pw),
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  }

# inverse transform
lal_trans_inverse <-
  function(tr, pw) {
    function(x) case_when (
      x <= -(abs(-tr)^(1/pw)) ~ -(abs(x)^(pw)),
      x >= tr^(1/pw) ~ x^pw,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  }
```

```{r figuren verschil per km larvaal, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
      scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(.$alternative))) +
      xlab("Distance from Vlissingen (km)") + ylab("") +

      theme_bw() +
```
